items.text: All 8 workshop decisions from rounds 1 and 2 were incorporated into plan.md. Round 1 decisions (validation-report.json sibling file, queue handler blocking, normalized keyword matching, structured markdown checklist) were already reflected in the plan drafted during round 1. Round 2 decisions (WorkshopSave trigger point, raw JSON string proto field, re-validate on GET for stale reports, header-presence-only content check) were confirmed and explicitly annotated in the Implementation Strategy and Contract Decisions sections.

Key round 2 confirmation: the finalize agent writes plan.md BEFORE calling WorkshopSave with the finalize round, so the post-validation hook in WorkshopSave is guaranteed to have plan.md available. This eliminates the race condition risk flagged in round 1 and is now documented in the plan's Current Technical Context and Risks sections.

The plan contains all 13 mandatory sections per implementation-plan-authoring skill, includes prompt-manager skill read commands in Required Reading, has a greenfield declaration, and ends with vrooli scenario restart in the rollout checklist. No remaining structural gaps.

All 5 readiness dimensions are at 3/3. The 6-phase implementation strategy (core validation, pre-gate, post-gate, queue blocking, API surface, UI components) has been validated against actual codebase insertion points. This item is ready for execution.

Initiative context: this item is the foundational piece of the swarm-manager-quality-gates initiative. The sibling items (meta-orchestration-native-sessions, initiative-level-oversight-design) build on the assumption that finalized plans are structurally complete. No cross-item dependencies block this item from proceeding.

plan_updates: Final synthesis pass. Annotated each Implementation Strategy phase with the specific workshop decision it implements (e.g., 'decision round 2, d1'). Updated Contract Decisions table to include round 2 choices (stale report handling, content depth check). Tightened Target End State to reference specific decision outcomes. No new sections or structural changes needed — the plan was already comprehensive after round 2.
